newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror April ad revenue up 9.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror April ad revenue up 9.6 pct.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said Wednesday advertising revenues for its newspaper publishing group for the five weeks ended May 4 increased 9.6 percent to $162.6 million from $148.4 million in the prior year.

For the eighteen weeks January 1, 1997 through May 4, 1997, total advertising revenues rose 6.9 percent to $553.8 million compared with $518.3 million for the period January 1, 1996, through May 5, 1996. The results for 1997 contained two fewer days than the 1996 results.
